post:
SELECT p.post_id,
       CASE WHEN p.author_id = :viewer_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_owner,
       ps.post_id AS stats_post_id, COALESCE(ps.views_count,0) AS views_count, COALESCE(ps.likes_count,0) AS likes_count,
       COALESCE(ps.comments_count,0) AS comments_count, COALESCE(ps.replies_count,0) AS replies_count,
       COALESCE(ps.retweets_count,0) AS retweets_count, COALESCE(ps.engagement_score,0) AS engagement_score,
       CASE WHEN ps.views_count > 0 THEN ROUND(ps.likes_count / ps.views_count, 4) ELSE 0 END AS like_rate
FROM n_posts p
LEFT JOIN n_post_stats ps ON ps.post_id = p.post_id AND p.author_id = :viewer_id
WHERE p.post_id = :target_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND fn_can_view_post(:viewer_id, p.post_id) = 1
summary:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT u.user_id FROM n_users u LEFT JOIN n_user_settings s ON s.user_id = u.user_id
  WHERE u.user_id = :target_id AND u.is_active = 1 AND (
    u.user_id = :viewer_id OR (COALESCE(s.profile_visibility, 'public') = 'public' AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b
      WHERE (b.user_id = :viewer_id AND b.target_user_id = u.user_id)
         OR (b.user_id = u.user_id AND b.target_user_id = :viewer_id)
    ))
  )
), visible_posts AS (
  SELECT p.post_id, p.created_at FROM n_posts p JOIN target t ON t.user_id = p.author_id
  WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND (t.user_id = :viewer_id OR p.visibility = 'public')
), stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_posts,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 END) AS posts_this_week,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 END) AS posts_this_month,
    COALESCE(SUM(ps.likes_count), 0) AS total_likes_received,
    COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ps.likes_count), 2), 0) AS avg_likes_per_post,
    COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ps.engagement_score), 2), 0) AS engagement_score
  FROM visible_posts p LEFT JOIN n_post_stats ps ON ps.post_id = p.post_id
)
SELECT t.user_id, a.total_posts, a.posts_this_week, a.posts_this_month, a.total_likes_received, a.avg_likes_per_post,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n_post_likes l WHERE t.user_id = :viewer_id AND l.user_id = t.user_id) AS total_likes_given,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n_comments c WHERE t.user_id = :viewer_id AND c.user_id = t.user_id AND c.is_deleted = 0) AS total_comments_made,
  a.engagement_score
FROM target t CROSS JOIN stats a
daily:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT user_id FROM n_users WHERE user_id = :target_id AND user_id = :viewer_id AND is_active = 1
), days AS (
  SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - (:days - LEVEL) AS day_start FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= :days
), daily AS (
  SELECT d.day_start,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n_posts p WHERE p.author_id = t.user_id AND p.is_deleted = 0
      AND p.created_at >= d.day_start AND p.created_at < d.day_start + 1) AS posts_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n_post_likes l JOIN n_posts p ON p.post_id = l.post_id
      WHERE p.author_id = t.user_id AND p.is_deleted = 0
      AND l.created_at >= d.day_start AND l.created_at < d.day_start + 1) AS likes_received,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n_comments c JOIN n_posts p ON p.post_id = c.post_id
      WHERE p.author_id = t.user_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND c.is_deleted = 0
      AND c.created_at >= d.day_start AND c.created_at < d.day_start + 1) AS comments_received,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n_posts r JOIN n_posts p ON p.post_id = r.repost_of_post_id
      WHERE p.author_id = t.user_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.post_type = 'repost'
      AND r.created_at >= d.day_start AND r.created_at < d.day_start + 1) AS retweets_received,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n_post_likes l WHERE l.user_id = t.user_id
      AND l.created_at >= d.day_start AND l.created_at < d.day_start + 1) AS likes_given,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n_comments c WHERE c.user_id = t.user_id AND c.is_deleted = 0
      AND c.created_at >= d.day_start AND c.created_at < d.day_start + 1) AS comments_made
  FROM target t CROSS JOIN days d
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(day_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, posts_count, likes_received, comments_received,
       retweets_received, likes_given, comments_made, likes_received + comments_received + retweets_received AS engagement_score
FROM daily ORDER BY day_start
